title: The Ultimate Dessert for Martial Arts
description:
The Ultimate Dessert for Martial Arts - Looking for an amazing dessert which enhances your Martial Arts & Kung Fu Skills while at the same time tastes great!  This is IT!  Please "Add to Your Favorites", "SHARE" with your friends, and Click "Like"!  "Subscribe" to our Kung Fu, Tai Chi, Qigong, and Martial Arts channel for more about the "Warriors Life"!  

Ingredients of the Amazing Raw Vegan Ice Cream for Martial Arts is:
1.  Frozen Bananas
2.  Frozen Blueberries
3.  Fresh Dates
4.  Vanilla
5.  Fresh Apricots
6.  I also usually add a dash of kelp powder and moringa tree leaves from my moringa trees! :)
